usedFor: Shopify takes orders and customers; anny runs the bookings. A “New Customer” in Shopify can run “Create Customer” in anny, and an “Order Cancelled” can run “Update Booking Status” to cancel.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Update Booking Status” in anny
bestTemplate.why: When an order is cancelled, the related booking can be accepted, rejected or cancelled to match, which frees the slot.

watchOut: “Update Booking Status” has to point at a specific booking, so keep a booking reference alongside the order. “Create Customer” can return an existing one by email.
